captions_and_metadata.description_scope: Adopted short four-paragraph user style; separate seven-chapter file. No old mandatory count/chapters/hashtags rule.

audio.scope: All 104 scheduled source waveforms against master and actual AAC, both stereo channels, with guarded silent intervals. No recognition or human-listening claim.

exact_audio_inheritance.scope: Exact encoded packets, timing, format, ADTS and stereo24bit48k decoded PCM identity; fresh104 stereo waveform comparisons are separately measured in this run. Recognition evidence inherits the identical signal, not a claim of new ASR.

source_design.used_fields: Only intended content_box/font size and authored text. Historical visible boxes, center errors and pass flags are not used.
source_design.observation_policy: Fixed expanded fields, all-glyph observation with boundary contact rejection; no target adjustment after measurement.
